_about: The 404s, 409s, 410s, 413s, 426s, 429s and 503s zenthros-api answers, as it writes them (pkg/api TestThe404sTheAPIAnswers; -update-refusals rewrites it). sdk/python/tests/test_api_refusals.py holds the SDK's HTTP client to taking each for what it means.

refusals.body: {"kind":"Status","apiVersion":"v1","metadata":{},"status":"Failure","message":"there is no job train in Workspace risk","reason":"NotFound","details":{"name":"train","group":"zenthros.ai","kind":"zenthrosjobs"},"code":404}

refusals.case: the Gateway has no such job
the job's machine no longer keeps its log
refusals.body: {"kind":"Status","apiVersion":"v1","metadata":{},"status":"Failure","message":"this job's log is no longer kept: the machine keeps the logs of its last 20 jobs; a job run with logs= keeps its whole log in your bucket","reason":"Gone","code":410}

refusals.case: the job's machine is not connected
refusals.body: {"kind":"Status","apiVersion":"v1","metadata":{},"status":"Failure","message":"the job's machine is not connected now (detached, stopped, or between two connections): its log stays on it (no agent connected for backend \"ct-1\")","reason":"Conflict","code":409}

refusals.case: the Workspace is not one the hub routes
a route the API does not have

refusals.body: {"kind":"Status","apiVersion":"v1","metadata":{},"status":"Failure","message":"the job is 3145729 bytes; the most is 3145728 bytes","reason":"RequestEntityTooLarge","code":413}

refusals.case: the Workspace keeps its most jobs
refusals.body: {"kind":"Status","apiVersion":"v1","metadata":{},"status":"Failure","message":"the hub keeps 1000 jobs of Workspace risk, the most: delete finished ones (zenthros.get(NAME).delete()) or wait for them to expire","reason":"TooManyRequests","code":429}

refusals.case: the code a job names by its digest is not on the hub
